hypotheses.name: Signed paired-throw basement–Laplace-gravity concordance under low-relief alluvial cover
layers: competition iso_grav_anom (Band 13, USGS DOI 10.5066/P9Z6SA1Z) + signed horizontal gravity vector: +iso_grav_anom_hg (Band 18, +dg/dx_east) and -iso_grav_anom_vg (Band 11, +dg/dy_north)
competition det_elev (Band 12, USGS DOI 10.5066/P9MQRCBY) and det_elev_slope (Band 19)
hypotheses.signature: Test antisymmetric flank profiles across +/-400 m strike-oriented corridors: a positive hanging-wall step in depth_to_base_surf (Band 15) and an antiparallel negative step in iso_grav_anom (Band 13) must share the same downthrown polarity AND coincide with an across-strike dipole zero-crossing of the footprint-masked, Gaussian-regularized (sigma = 400-600 m, avoiding 100 m gravity resampling noise) Laplace vertical gravity curvature g_zz = -(d_x iso_grav_anom_hg (Band 18) - d_y iso_grav_anom_vg (Band 11)) along >=900 m strike continuity, weighted higher where det_elev_slope (Band 19) scarp relief is muted by Holocene basin fill, and tested against a polarity-scrambled control at identical 300 m submodular emission budget.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Hypothesis: burial by alluvial or playa sediments may obscure surface scarps where det_elev_slope (Band 19) is muted while leaving concordant basement-depth, gravity-step, and Laplace g_zz dipole signatures across blind intrabasin growth faults. Test enrichment on withheld whole segments before claiming preferential recovery of catalogue-missing faults; depth_to_base_surf (Band 15) and iso_grav_anom (Band 13) share USGS OFR 99-383 gravity-inversion ancestry and must not be treated as independent evidence without provenance checks.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: All executed GEMSDOE86 lanes (GMC, RMRB, WVB, GFCO, KSLB, CTHB) discard cross-flank dip-slip polarity concordance; PR #60 claimed signed paired-throw in prose without ever opening training_features.tif (IR-86-SPT-02); GEMSDOE89 BH-RTP-HABC uses unsigned basement-hinge curvature and GEMSDOE91 S11-MHTR feeds unsigned Marussi Hessian eigenvalues to trees rather than enforcing directional antiparallel throw + Laplace g_zz dipole parity inside low-slope basin interiors.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted pre-Tertiary erosional paleovalley margins or buried caldera moat walls infilled by low-density tuffaceous basin sediments; gravity-basement inversion artifacts (USGS OFR 99-383).
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: First qualitative testing priority among local-feature candidates, not measured or projected DTI improvement. Historical owner-reported scores cannot establish which geological regime caused a difference.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-medium: oriented +/-400 m antisymmetric flank filters, footprint-masked Laplace g_zz curvature from Bands 11 & 18, polarity-scrambled control, and existing 300 m submodular decoder.
hypotheses.data_readiness: NOT_READY: raw competition layers have pinned mirrors and pixel-verified vector physics, but execution remains blocked by protocol_preflight.require_feasible() under the literal 17GEMSDOE dense-witness rule.

hypotheses.name: Cross-corridor GeoDAWN magnetic marker-horizon phase-correlation offset & native radiometric TC decoupling
layers: analytical magnetic tilt angle theta_mag = atan2[tmi_vg (Band 9), tmi_hg (Band 3)] derived from competition Bands 3 and 9
competition tc (Band 6, pixel-verified GeoDAWN Airborne Radiometric Total Count TC, r = +0.997140) and optional mirrored geodawn_rad_u8.tif K/Th/U ratios
hypotheses.signature: Hypothesis: phase-correlate transverse rtp (Band 2) and analytical magnetic tilt theta_mag = atan2[tmi_vg (Band 9), tmi_hg (Band 3)] marker ridges on opposite +/-700 m flanks of label-free candidate corridors. Require consistent nonzero lateral translation across adjacent strike windows and compare with zero-shift and phase-scrambled controls. Do not use tc until authoritative organizer metadata confirms its pixel-verified GeoDAWN Radiometric Total Count TC identity (r = +0.997140; never treat tc (Band 6) as magnetic tilt). Estimate survey-seam directions from acquisition metadata before defining a seam veto, rather than assuming fixed compass azimuths.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Accommodation-zone transfer faults and oblique Walker Lane / Humboldt relay structures cut buried Tertiary volcanic sheets across basin floors without building prominent range-front topographic scarps, leaving coherent lateral marker offsets (200-1500 m; USGS PP 1658 ch. 5) where surface mapping is blank.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: GFCO compares TMI (Band 14) with upward-continued TMI; GMC computes cross-gradients between iso_grav_anom (Band 13) and rtp (Band 2); WVB, CTHB, and sibling ANASIG/BH-RTP-HABC lanes measure point-local analytic-signal or tilt ridges rather than two-sided flank-to-flank lateral phase translation lag; moreover, this formulation corrects IR-86-BAND6-TC-MISLABEL-20261024 by computing true magnetic tilt from Bands 9/3.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted intrusive contacts, primary Miocene lava-flow lobe terminations, GeoDAWN E-W (200/400 m) flight-line and N-S (2000/4000 m) tie-line leveling seams, and remanent magnetization reversals.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Second qualitative priority: physically orthogonal strike-slip / transfer-zone detector using 100% competition-native bands (plus optional mirrored GeoDAWN K/Th/U) without external downloads. No score projection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium-high: multi-azimuth split-window FFT phase correlation, E-W/N-S survey-seam suppression, and buffered LOQO validation (~65 min CPU, within 2 hr session cap).
hypotheses.data_readiness: NOT_READY: blocked prior to feature construction by protocol_preflight.require_feasible() under the pinned dense-witness overlap stop.

hypotheses.name: Hydrothermal magnetite-destruction trough & pairwise paleo-vent/sinter strike-alignment corridor
layers: competition rtp (Band 2), tmi_vg (Band 9), cond_surf (Band 17), tc (Band 6 = GeoDAWN Radiometric Total Count), geod_dilaterate (Band 8), and geod_shearrate (Band 7)
mirrored DOE GDR 1391 paleo_geothermal_regional.zip (726 sinter/tufa deposits, sha256 faffcf69...) and 2m_temperature_probe_INGENIOUS_regional_data.zip (3,800 probes, sha256 1301f70d...)
mirrored DOE GDR 1391 gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint.csv and gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv (excluding dist_known_fault_px) + geodawn_extensions_u8.tif K/Th & U/Th
hypotheses.signature: Hypothesis: extract strike-continuous rtp (Band 2) minima with positive cross-strike second derivative of rtp (equivalently negative second derivative of -rtp) and positive volcanic flanking shoulders, co-located with shallow smectite-illite conductivity cond_surf (Band 17) and pairwise co-linear geodesic corridors (<=6 km) connecting paleo-sinter/tufa mounds, 2-m temperature anomalies, and Quaternary volcanic vents inside dilatant crust where geod_dilaterate (Band 8) > 0, evaluated against phase-scrambled and point-location controls. A magnetic trough alone is not diagnostic of hydrothermal magnetite destruction; remanent magnetization reversals, source geometry, primary felsic lithology, and acquisition seams can produce minima, and tmi_vg (Band 9) extrema need not share rtp polarity.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Hypothesis: hydrothermal alteration along buried blind conduits may reduce magnetic susceptibility and form argillic/sinter zones along subtle intrabasin stepovers, horse-tail splays, and relay ramps without a mapped Holocene surface scarp; test enrichment on withheld buffered fault components rather than assuming a vent alignment implies an unmapped fault.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86D-CTHB extracted only positive magnetic Hessian ridges (mag_ridge_s15) and radially isotropic point halos around sinter/volcanic vents (paleo_sinter_vent, volcanic_vent_halo); no lane in GEMSDOE86 extracts negative flanking-shoulder magnetite-destruction troughs or pairwise co-linear vent-to-vent geodesic corridors.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Non-tectonic reversed-polarity volcanic flows, felsic ash-flow tuffs with primary low magnetic susceptibility, saline playa pans, or E-W/N-S GeoDAWN tie-line troughs.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Third qualitative testing priority; no measured or projected DTI gain. The competition prediction target is missing fault traces, not direct vent classification, and mirrored point layers require provenance and catalogue-leakage checks before use.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium: signed valley-curvature filter on rtp, pairwise vent-alignment Radon/geodesic corridor builder, and buffered whole-component LOQO (~45 min CPU).
hypotheses.data_readiness: NOT_READY: all competition and GDR 1391 sinter/2m-probe/vent inputs are SHA-pinned on GitHub mirrors (research/h86d_extended_manifest.json), but execution remains blocked by protocol_preflight.require_feasible() under the literal 17GEMSDOE dense-witness rule.

hypotheses.name: Multi-depth 3D MT conductance contrast x conductive heat-flow & analytical magnetic-tilt sharpening
layers: external USGS Great Basin 3D MT electrical conductance slices (5 depth ranges 2-200 km, DOI 10.5066/P9TWT2LU)
external USGS Great Basin conductive heat-flow grids (DOI 10.5066/P9BZPVUC)
competition cond_surf (Band 17), geod_dilaterate (Band 8), geod_shearrate (Band 7), tmi_hg (Band 3), and tmi_vg (Band 9)
hypotheses.signature: Hypothesis: compare conductance gradients across verified MT depth intervals, conductive heat-flow highs, and competition geod_dilaterate (Band 8) > 0 to separate subvertical fault-fluid conduits from shallow playa brines, sharpened along analytical magnetic tilt zero-crossings theta_mag = atan2[tmi_vg (Band 9), tmi_hg (Band 3)] = 0. First verify official release depth bins and native grid resolution rather than assuming coarse regional MT grids resolve 100 m fault corridors. Exclude tc until authoritative organizer metadata confirms Band 6 semantics (pixel-verified here as GeoDAWN Radiometric Total Count TC, r = +0.997140, IR-86-BAND6-TC-MISLABEL-20261024).
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Blind hydrothermal fault conduits in the Humboldt structural zone and northern Walker Lane frequently lack Holocene surface scarps and modern catalog seismicity, yet deep saline upflow + smectite-illite clay alteration produce multi-kilometer MT conductance steps inside actively dilating crust.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: training_features.tif provides only single-surface cond_surf (Band 17) plus geodetic bands (Bands 4, 7, 8), which conflate shallow playa brines with deep fault conduits; no GEMSDOE86 lane ingests the 5-depth USGS 3D MT conductance slices (10.5066/P9TWT2LU) or USGS conductive heat-flow release (10.5066/P9BZPVUC).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Stratiform Paleozoic graphitic/sulfidic marine black shales (e.g., Roberts Mountains thrust allochthon) generating deep non-geothermal crustal conductance.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Fourth qualitative priority: resolves the shallow-playa vs deep-conduit ambiguity of Band 17 cond_surf, gated behind ScienceBase raster mirroring and coarse-to-100 m downscaling verification. No score projection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium-high: USGS ScienceBase archive pinning, EPSG:32611 reprojection, depth-ratio differencing, leakage-canary check, and buffered holdout testing (~75 min CPU once mirrored).
hypotheses.free_official_source_needed: USGS ScienceBase Electrical Conductance Maps of the Great Basin (https://doi.org/10.5066/P9TWT2LU, Peacock & Bedrosian 2022) and Heat Flow Maps of the Great Basin (https://doi.org/10.5066/P9BZPVUC, DeAngelo et al. 2022), public domain.
hypotheses.obtainability: NOT_VERIFIED_THIS_SESSION: the listed USGS DOI releases are prospective official sources. ScienceBase and DOI hosts are outside the sandbox allowlist; official archive bytes, depth intervals, license and spatial coverage have not been independently retrieved here.
hypotheses.data_readiness: NOT_VIABLE_YET: official multi-depth MT and heat-flow bytes, metadata, coverage and license require verification and pinning; protocol preflight also blocks execution.

hypotheses.name: Watershed-crossing 1-m 3DEP LiDAR micro-scarp curvature persistence
layers: official USGS 3DEP bare-earth 1 m DEM tiles (competition 1m_DEM_links.csv)
hypotheses.signature: Measure signed 5-25 m cross-strike profile curvature steps on native 1 m bare-earth LiDAR DEMs that retain strike and downthrown polarity across >=3 independently delineated drainage divides, vetoing candidates aligned with steepest-descent channels, constant-elevation pluvial shorelines, or road embankments.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Low-slip (0.3-1.5 m) late Quaternary piedmont and intrabasin scarps are smoothed below noise in 30-100 m DEM products (det_elev Band 12, det_elev_slope Band 19) and missed in pre-LiDAR airphoto mapping, yet persist cleanly across multiple ephemeral fan catchments at 1 m LiDAR resolution.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Zero GEMSDOE86 lanes ingest raw native 1 m 3DEP LiDAR tiles (prior lanes used only pre-quantized 100 m summary bands in lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif without cross-divide polarity persistence).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shoreline benches, fluvial terrace risers, and highway/railroad grades.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Fifth qualitative testing priority because native-resolution processing and data acquisition are costly; no measured or projected DTI improvement.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High: native-resolution terrain processing and drainage-divide conditioning. Not admitted within this session budget until a measured small-area benchmark establishes feasibility; stop at the two-hour limit.
hypotheses.free_official_source_needed: USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth DEM GeoTIFFs indexed by the competition's 1m_DEM_links.csv (documented in https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96647.pdf).
hypotheses.obtainability: NOT_VERIFIED_THIS_SESSION: USGS 3DEP is the prospective official source. Native tiles and the competition coverage manifest are absent; official tile hosts are outside this sandbox allowlist. No claim of current download availability is made.
hypotheses.data_readiness: NOT_VIABLE_YET: native 1 m DEM tiles and coverage manifest are not present in this checkout, and protocol_preflight.require_feasible() blocks model execution.

AND the 13GEMSDOE 99.87%-covered stride-5 discrete dot lattice b4570b40..., which forces >=82.70% 3-px overlap on any 37,654-dot raster by pigeonhole); never patch vendor/gems57 privately.

Freeze buffered whole-component folds and fixed budgets before touching withheld labels; derive every catalogue feature strictly from fold-visible faults outside the buffer (never mask full existing_faults.tif as PR #60 did).
Run single-feature and combined leakage canaries before trusting any holdout number; max(AUC, 1-AUC) > 0.90 stops the run, and AUC <= 0.52 flags a non-informative feature.

Use the pinned shared evaluate_holdout.py and submission_writer.py unchanged; report pooled HOLDOUT-DTI with evaluator version, withheld-positive pixel count, physical-block 95% CI, and paired delta vs H86D-CTHB and fold-fair R0.
At most 3 experiments or 2 hours per session; negative results are first-class deliverables, and promotion to a DrivenData weekly submission slot remains a separate selector step.
evidence_boundary: All physical signatures, catalogue-missing rationales and benefit rankings below are untested hypotheses, not verified discoveries or expected scores. Official URLs identify prospective sources, not fresh verification of their contents. Owner mirrors do not authenticate organizer data.
historical_status_note: This file preserves the original five-candidate preregistration and its then-current experiments_run=0 / NOT_RUN statuses; those statuses are not a statement of current experiment history. The H86E archive later tested the standalone signed paired-throw basement/gravity method without Laplace gravity curvature and reported it negative. That test did not implement the distinct Laplace-curvature extension described by the original H86E-SPBT candidate.
